description.value: The Revelstoke Museum & Archives is a two-floor history museum celebrating the heritage of Revelstoke and the surrounding Columbia River region, with exhibits spanning Indigenous peoples, early settlement, railways, mining, forestry, and multicultural history. It also stewards Revelstoke's only downtown Heritage Garden and offers audio tours, guided walking tours, and active archival research services. One UK visitor noted it 'punches way above its weight' for grounding travellers in the history and character of this mountain corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, well-maintained history museum and archives in downtown Revelstoke, with recent curator blog posts through May 2026 and a full range of programming. OSM and the website agree on the address and website URL; the phone number (250) 837-3067 is sourced from the website only as OSM carried no phone field. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) are explicitly mentioned in the website text, and the amenities section on the Visit Us page was truncated in the fetch, leaving those fields unverifiable.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating cultural attraction in downtown Revelstoke; a legitimate and worthwhile stop for touring cyclists exploring the Columbia River corridor.
